name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
department: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt of India
short_description: Financial scholarship for Class 9 and Class 10 minority students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) with family income <= Rs. 1 Lakh.
detailed_description: Provides financial assistance to students belonging to notified minority communities studying in Class 9 and 10 in government and government-aided schools, with at least 50% marks in the previous final examination and family income not exceeding Rs. 1.00 Lakh.
description_kannada: ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರದಿಂದ ಅಧಿಸೂಚಿತಗೊಂಡ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ 9 ಮತ್ತು 10 ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು ನೀಡುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ.

rules.name: Must belong to Minority Community
rules.clarification_question_en: Do you belong to a notified religious minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi)?
rules.clarification_question_kn: ನೀವು ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಸಮುದಾಯಕ್ಕೆ (ಮುಸ್ಲಿಂ, ಕ್ರಿಶ್ಚಿಯನ್, ಸಿಖ್, ಬೌದ್ಧ, ಜೈನ, ಪಾರ್ಸಿ) ಸೇರಿದವರೇ?

rules.name: Annual Family Income <= Rs. 1 Lakh
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your total annual family income?

rules.name: Must be an active student
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you currently studying in school?

benefits_summary: Admission and tuition fee grant up to Rs. 4,000 + maintenance allowance of Rs. 500/month for 10 months.
required_documents: Income certificate by competent revenue authority
Aadhaar Card and student bank account details
application_process: Authenticate with student OTR and Aadhaar eKYC.
source_title: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India
source_excerpt: Scholarship will be awarded to students who have secured not less than 50% marks in the previous final examination and annual income does not exceed Rs. 1.00 lakh.
